blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of the National Defense (DND) on Thursday said that it looks forward to enforcing the Status of Visiting Forces Agreement (SOVFA) with France. This follows the Senate’s approval, with 17 affirmative votes, of Senate Resolution No. 650 on third reading, which concurs with the ratification of the proposed visiting forces agreement between the Philippines and France. READ: Senate panel approves PH SOVFA with France “We look forward to the entry into force of the SOVFA with France and to further strengthening our defense partnership for the benefit of our peoples and the Indo-Pacific region,” the DND said […]...
